name: Homer
tagline: A very simple static homepage for your server
description:
Homer

A dead simple static HOMepage for your servER to keep your services on hand, from a simple yaml configuration file.

Demo • Chat • Getting started

## Features - [yaml](http://yaml.org/) file configuration - Installable (pwa) - Search - Grouping - Theme customization - Offline health check - keyboard shortcuts: - `/` Start searching. - `Escape` Stop searching. - `Enter` Open the first matching result (respects the bookmark's `_target` property). - `Alt`/`Option` + `Enter` Open the first matching result in a new tab.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  homer:
    image: b4bz/homer:v26.08.3
    container_name: homer
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/www/assets
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:8080
